messages:
Mia Patel: AP flagged an invoice from Veridian Systems for $18,750 — PO mismatch/absent. invoice #2026-0987. Vendor put PO `420-REDW-2026` but our active PO is `420-REDW-2025`. PDF: https://files.redwood/veridian/2026-0987.pdf
AP-Bot: Invoice 2026-0987 placed on hold (reason: PO not found). Hold expiry: 2026-06-18.
Samir Khan: Can you paste the invoice header and line items? need to confirm GL and project code.
Mia Patel: sure — header & totals: ```vendor: Veridian Systems
invoice: 2026-0987
date: 2026-05-29
amount: 18,750.00 USD
po_on_invoice: 420-REDW-2026
line1: Managed GPU hours - model-infra - 18,750.00```
Jenna Lee: That charge is for model-infra cluster for the Redwood-Model team — should be on Eng infra PO `420-REDW-2025`. Vendor must have used the wrong PO when billing. This is not a new spend, same budget.
Samir Khan: OK - so two options: vendor issues corrected invoice with correct PO, or Procurement/Finance create an amendment. AP won't approve without matching PO. @Luis can you advise?
Luis Ortega: I can take this. AP policy: invoices must match PO number exactly. I'll contact Veridian for a corrected invoice and cc AP. If vendor refuses, I'll create a PO amendment (AMND-420-11) to cover this invoice and route for approval.
Mia Patel: thanks. any chance to manually approve to avoid late fees? AP system says no, it will fail audit. :grimacing: 
Samir Khan: don't manually approve. If we do a one-off, we need a memo + approver sign-off. prefer corrected invoice or amendment.
Luis Ortega: Draft email to vendor: ```Hi Veridian team,
Our AP placed invoice #2026-0987 on hold due to an incorrect PO number. Please reissue the invoice with PO 420-REDW-2025 and reference our original invoice number. Alternatively, confirm acceptance of a PO amendment from Redwood (AMND-420-11).
Thanks,
Luis Ortega (Procurement)``` I'll send now and paste the vendor reply here.
AP-Bot: Reminder: invoices without a matching PO will be held and may be subject to late payment interest after hold expiry. :warning:
Mia Patel: copied. tagging procurement-approvers for visibility. :eyes: Please update when you hear back, Luis.
Luis Ortega: sent to vendor at 2026-05-29 14:12 PT. Created PO amendment AMND-420-11 as a contingency and routed for manager approval. Will update thread.
Mia Patel: perfect — thanks all. If vendor provides corrected invoice, send to AP inbox and I'll push the release once matched.
